scenarios.desc: A missing main baseline is mistaken for a broken probe.
scenarios.input: An ai-agents PR has red Validate PR. The triage probe returns PR_ONLY. We already widened history once. Give the next action and what can be claimed. Do not modify anything.
scenarios.rationale: The current typed verdict distinguishes absent rows from failed retrieval.

scenarios.desc: A green result has the wrong integration and revision.
scenarios.input: The required ai-agents check has a green same-name run from another integration on the prior head. The name-only triage probe says GREEN_ON_MAIN. Can we proceed? Give the next read. Do not modify anything.
scenarios.rationale: Same-name rollups omit producer identity required for acceptance.

scenarios.desc: Ordinary code generation does not need PR recovery.
scenarios.input: Write a pure Python function that adds two integers. Return only code.
scenarios.rationale: No hosted PR blocker or check attribution exists.
